text:
Asha: Morning team — quick async standup. Yesterday: landed slot-alignment tweak for the kernel (PR #4827). Observed p95 for short prompts drop from ~120ms -> ~98ms in canary.
Derek: Nice! Did you run the same warmup profile as the last run?
Asha: yes — 10k short prompts, same seed. I also disabled microbatch coalescing for that run to measure solo improvement.
Yvonne: Blockers for rollout? Anything that could regress tail latency under burst?
Asha: Main worry is KV cache thrash when we enable alignment + aggressive prefetch. In one noisy run eviction rate jumped 2x. Need to tweak eviction threshold.
Ethan: I can take the eviction tuning today. Suggest starting from current threshold 0.65 -> 0.8 and run short A/B for 30m.
Sam: ping me for perf infra changes — I have a small fix for the benchmark harness that normalizes slot drift. Will push a patch to bench infra.
bench-bot: benchmark job queued: job/2026-03-18-evict-tune-1 (compare: canary vs baseline). ETA ~ 40m.
Derek: Quick CR ping: Asha, can you add a short note in PR #4827 about the prefetched-KV side effects? There was an edge-case on shard handoff.
Asha: good call, adding comments now. Also leaving a TODO to add a test that simulates cross-shard warmup.
Yvonne: For rollout plan — propose canary 5% for 2h, collect p50/p95/p99 + eviction-rate + OOMs. If stable, 25% for 3h then full. Any objections?
Ethan: sounds good. I'll own the 5% monitoring dashboard and alerts.
Sam: I'll coordinate infra deploy window, prefer 10:30 PST so CI warmup is quieter.
Derek: tiny config snippet we should use for the bench run:
```
kernel: 
  slot_align: true
  microbatch_coalesce: false
kv: 
  eviction_threshold: 0.8
  prefetch_window_ms: 60
```
Asha: thanks — will copy that into the canary config.
bench-bot: benchmark completed: canary p95=100ms, baseline p95=118ms, eviction-rate +1.9x. Detailed logs at https://bench.local/jobs/2026-03-18-evict-tune-1
Yvonne: eviction bump is expected. Ethan, if the 0.8 threshold still thrashes, can you try increasing prefetch_window_ms to 120 or reduce prefetch concurrency?
Ethan: yup will try window=120 and concurrency=2 next. Kicking off run now.
Asha: blockers for today: none besides monitoring the canary. PLs ping in-thread for anything urgent.
Derek: I'll review PR #4827 later this morning. Small question: do we need a regression eval for long prompts?
Asha: good point — adding a quick 1k long prompt eval to the suite, should be fast.
Sam: tagging @infra-schedule to reserve 10:30 PST window.
Yvonne: thanks all — short and actionable. :thumbsup:
